propositions: Strict eval-spec validation currently runs only as an inline Python step in prompt-eval.yml workflow, which is not referenced by gerrit-verify.yaml and does not gate the Verified vote.
Three plan-review specs (asserted-capability, decomp-shape, necessity) shipped with dataset but no gold_set and merged with Verified +1 while prompt-eval.yml was red, exposing the gating gap.
The default pytest suite runs in build-and-test.yml and gates Verified, but eval-spec validation is absent from the unit test suite (test_new_eval_specs.py only checks a hardcoded 3-spec tuple).

A new glob-based unit test in tests/unit/test_eval_scorers.py must assert validate_eval_spec(spec) passes for all packaged specs and validate_eval_spec(spec, strict=True) passes for all dataset-bearing specs.
The redundant inline validation step must be removed from prompt-eval.yml after the unit test is added and verified to gate pre-merge.
